checks.exact_action: Open the built app in a desktop browser and look at the page on load without interacting.
checks.expected_result: A calculator is visible with display showing 0, and a themed page background with a psychedelic gradient.

checks.exact_action: Click 2, +, 3, x, 4, = with the mouse, then click C, then enter 5, /, 0, = and then click 7.
checks.expected_result: 2+3x4= shows 20; C resets to 0; 5/0= shows Error; pressing 7 afterward starts a fresh number showing 7.

checks.exact_action: Without clicking any button, press keys 2 + 3 * 4 Enter, then Backspace, Escape, then the letter x, then 1 . . 2.
checks.expected_result: Mapped keys behave like their buttons (20 after Enter, Escape clears to 0), letter x changes nothing, and a second decimal point is ignored (1.2); pressed keys briefly highlight their buttons.

checks.exact_action: Enter 0.1 + 0.2 = and then type a 20-digit number and compute 999999999999 x 999999999999.
checks.expected_result: 0.3 displays; typed entry stops at 12 digits; the huge product shows in exponential form; text never spills outside the display box.

checks.exact_action: Visually judge the page background, button colors, fonts and rounded buttons for a groovy 1970s feel (burnt orange, mustard, avocado, brown, cream) and label readability.
checks.expected_result: Reviewer records a verdict of groovy and legible, or marks it waived/unverified; it is never assumed to pass.

checks.evidence_to_capture: Screenshot or typed display values after each Enter.
checks.exact_action: Open the app in a desktop browser. Without clicking anything, press 2, +, 3, *, 4, Enter. Then press 0, ., 1, +, 0, ., 2, Enter.
checks.expected_result: First chain shows 20 (left-to-right, no precedence). Second shows 0.3, not 0.30000000000000004.
